title: pyrus hibernica
intro: Pyrus hibernica, commonly known as Irish rowan, is a species of rowan native to Ireland. This deciduous shrub or small tree is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and exhibiting antioxidant activities. The health benefits of Irish rowan include its ability to boost the immune system, protect against cardiovascular disease, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus hibernica include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
